scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:web && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:rust
scripts.test: node --test scripts/architecture.test.mjs && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run test:e2e -w apps/web
scripts.generate:api: docker compose run --rm --no-deps api cargo run --locked --bin export-openapi > openapi.json && npm run generate:api -w apps/web
scripts.check:web: npm run check -w apps/web && npm run lint:scripts && npm run check -w @appshell/ui
scripts.check:architecture: node scripts/check-architecture.mjs && node scripts/rust.mjs test --locked --test architecture
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:rust && npm run build && npm run build:storybook && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:mail && npm run test:storybook
